tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成

device_entry.description: Opentrons 温度模块是一种用于实验室自动化平台的温控附件，可对样品板或其他小型实验容器进行加热或冷却并维持设定温度，常用于样品孵育、试剂保冷及温度敏感实验流程。
device_entry.description_en: The Opentrons Temperature Module is a temperature-control accessory for laboratory automation platforms. It heats or cools microplates or other small lab containers and maintains a set temperature for sample incubation, reagent cooling, and other temperature-sensitive workflows.
